ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The image shows a vertical rectangular strip/line on the left representing the charged plate. Points A and B are on the same side of the plate to its right, and B is farther from the plate than A. Reasoning: The problem states the electric field is generated by an infinitely large charged plate. An infinite charged plate produces a uniform electric field whose magnitude does not depend on distance from the plate. Since the same charge moves from A to B, q is unchanged, and the electric force is F = qE. Because E is the same at A and B, the electric force remains the same.
